decisions.reason: Dedicated presentation in both 2018 and 2019 suggests results at least met aspiration levels, and the product fits the firm's core drainage technology and system-family logic.

Its visibility improved from a mere mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, indicating performance above aspiration and strong alignment with the firm's strategic move toward floor-level shower systems.
The move from its own page in 2018 to only a mention in 2019 suggests falling attention versus aspiration, so resources are better redirected to stronger shower-drainage offerings.

Although only mentioned rather than prominently featured, it directly supports installation ease and integrated shower solutions, so a firm with some slack would retain this complementary product in the family.
From a standalone launch to home-page visibility, this product appears to have exceeded aspiration levels and uses the firm's established drainage know-how in a credible adjacent application.
Repeatedly receiving only low-level mention and being less central to the firm's distinctive integrated drainage systems suggests underperformance relative to aspiration and weak strategic priority.
